taskVersion.name: ves-heldout-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station H-01 (survey area H). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 332.5 | 0.52 | 0.52
2 | 601.3 | 6.89 | 7.41
3 | 359.9 | 16.01 | 23.42
4 | 286.0 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: H-01
Curve type: KQ-type ($\rho_1 < \rho_2 > \rho_3 > \rho_4$)
Aquifer depth: 7.41 to >30 m (weathered horizon from 7.41–23.42 m, deeper saturated fractured zone below 23.42 m)
Recommendation: Drill to a target depth of 35–45 m to fully penetrate the low-resistivity water-bearing zone underlying the resistive overburden. Install well screens within the permeable intervals below 7.41 m and into the fractured basement.
